name: Organelle
description: Two organelles to a cell, one round, one long, both a little irregular.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; top: 14%; width: 40%; height: 72%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: @repeat(4, @rand(30%, 70%)) / @repeat(4, @rand(30%, 70%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 54%; top: 26%; width: 38%; height: 48%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: @repeat(4, @rand(30%, 70%)) / @repeat(4, @rand(30%, 70%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
